records.subject: test(linux): discover native source trees without LuaFileSystem
records.bug: Native source discovery dropped POSIX backslashes and LF without LuaFileSystem.
records.root_cause: Line-oriented find and separator rewriting treated opaque filenames as text.
records.regression_proof: Ordinary/backslash/LF real trees with and without lfs; complete native inventory and manifest.
records.os_scope: Common Bash fixture; Linux POSIX execution, Windows canonical conversion retained.

records.subject: fix(linux): retain watcher ownership through runtime cleanup
records.bug: Runtime shutdown claimed completion with two watcher handles still open after a pump error.
records.root_cause: Main dropped the watcher reference before native close acknowledgment.
records.regression_proof: Six stop return/exception cases retain ownership until native retirement and handle drain.
records.os_scope: Linux runtime and watcher lifecycle only.

records.subject: test(linux): use the canonical system capture clock origin
records.bug: A fixture turned a 120000 ms capture into 119999 ms in SQLite.
records.root_cause: A fabricated fractional monotonic origin violated the canonical Calendar contract.
records.regression_proof: Use Calendar.capture().mono_ms; preserve native duration and existing assertions.
records.os_scope: Linux capture and SQLite fixtures only.

records.subject: fix(linux): require successful logger probe allocation
records.bug: A failed mktemp probe could write or remove a foreign file or symlink.
records.root_cause: Output was accepted as exclusive ownership without checking allocation success.
records.regression_proof: Real exit-73 child leaves foreign file/symlink intact; successful real allocation is the positive control.
records.os_scope: Linux logger allocation only.

records.subject: fix(linux): derive locale availability from native files
records.bug: Locale discovery admitted directories, invented LF-delimited languages and partial catalogues.
records.root_cause: Unchecked shell output substituted for native file evidence.
records.regression_proof: Real file enumeration, observation refusal, LF names and file-type controls.
records.os_scope: Linux runtime locale catalogue only.

records.subject: fix(linux): restore startup preferences after publication failures
records.bug: A failed startup publication could leave preferences changed.
records.root_cause: Publication preceded admission and rollback did not restore late refusals.
records.regression_proof: 15 source/mode/publication/service-order/recovery scenarios, reconciled with dev i18n.
records.os_scope: Linux installation and start_at_login only.

records.subject: test(linux): preserve rejected native fixture diagnostics
records.bug: Native PAC failure diagnostics could disappear before an assertion returned.
records.root_cause: Evidence was emitted after assertions instead of before propagating failure.
records.regression_proof: Real exit-73 and ENOBUFS children retain complete stdout/stderr.
records.os_scope: Common native PAC fixture executed on Linux; no native Mac/Windows claim.

records.subject: test(linux): isolate missing native XKB includes
records.bug: The missing-XKB-data negative control failed on newer libxkbcommon.
records.root_cause: A self-contained keymap needed no include; compiled search paths invalidated the premise.
records.regression_proof: Unique genuinely required include omitted then restored alone; native 1.7/1.13 and positives preserved.
records.os_scope: Linux XKB data and distro controls only.

records.subject: test(linux): retain private native network failure evidence
records.bug: Native network failures lost status, signal, PID, errors and captured bytes.
records.root_cause: The gate replaced child receipts with a fixed generic message.
records.regression_proof: Seven actual controls: exit73, SIGTERM, ENOBUFS, ENOENT, false receipt, empty buffer and umask.
records.os_scope: Linux native network evidence only.

records.subject: test(linux): stage native proxy policy before schema admission
records.bug: The schema-absence control failed at an unrelated prerequisite.
records.root_cause: The fixture omitted the canonical proxy policy before schema/backend admission.
records.regression_proof: Real policy absence followed by canonical copy reaches the original backend refusal; four native groups retained.
records.os_scope: Linux native network fixture only.

records.subject: test(linux): preserve native paths across Bash fixture boundaries
records.bug: Ten Bash fixture callers corrupted valid POSIX paths.
records.root_cause: Callers duplicated conversion and rewrote backslashes before real producers.
records.regression_proof: Old-red/new-green ordinary/backslash/LF paths, canonical Bash owner and original assertions.
records.os_scope: Common path boundary; POSIX bytes and Windows conversion each retain their native contract.

records.subject: fix(linux): preserve native paths when copying tar payloads
records.bug: Tar payload copying failed on backslash paths and could proceed after archive refusal.
records.root_cause: GNU tar interpreted backslashes in -C and the live wrapper did not enforce the pipeline receipt.
records.regression_proof: Native chdir before tar; creation/extraction/redirection refusals stop before install; genuine payload witnesses.
records.os_scope: Linux payload copy and live wrapper only.

records.subject: fix(linux): restore owned files after failed uninstall
records.bug: Late uninstall refusal could remove runtime files and the uninstaller itself.
records.root_cause: Owned files were not retained through transaction completion; incomplete observation was treated as absence.
records.regression_proof: 13 native EACCES/inaccessible-source/snapshot/restoration/retry tests using the installed worker.
records.os_scope: Linux uninstaller transaction only.

records.subject: test(linux): isolate instrumentation logger identities
records.bug: Instrumentation tests depended on execution order and observed a different logger from the real guard.
records.root_cause: Three fixtures replaced logger identities without restoring private consumers.
records.regression_proof: Original full suite 19811 pass/1 fail; three causal reproductions; seven cold/warm/exception regressions.
records.os_scope: Linux instrumentation fixtures; production unchanged.

records.subject: fix(linux): handle help before acquiring launcher resources
records.bug: Requesting help with tray could start systemd or request privilege.
records.root_cause: Help classification occurred after service/polkit/group acquisition.
records.regression_proof: Old launcher starts service or calls pkexec then exits78; 48 added scenarios and 12 real Bash-to-LuaJIT help paths.
records.os_scope: Linux launcher only; help requires no system resource acquisition.

records.subject: test(linux): preserve managed Python fixture path bytes
records.bug: Managed-Python fixtures rejected valid backslash paths.
records.root_cause: Three local conversions bypassed the canonical Bash path owner.
records.regression_proof: Old real Bash exit127; 18 corrected ordinary/backslash/LF calls with architecture/refusal assertions retained.
records.os_scope: Common Bash fixture; POSIX preservation and Windows conversion retained.

records.subject: fix(linux): propagate updater cadence scheduling refusals
records.bug: Update cadence menus reported success after timer retirement/replacement refusal.
records.root_cause: The callback ignored stop/start receipts and duplicated cancellation already owned by start.
records.regression_proof: Four old-red/new-green false/nil/text stop and unarmed replacement controls; durable preference receipt retained.
records.os_scope: Linux timer/menu owner; analogous Mac source remains an unproved candidate.

records.subject: fix(linux): preserve source watcher path boundaries
records.bug: Nested source edits did not restart a daemon under an LF-containing root.
records.root_cause: find -print and line readers split filenames and discarded child status.
records.regression_proof: Polling and genuine inotify reproduction; nine regressions, eight old-red; Lua5.4 targeted 9/9.
records.os_scope: Linux source watcher only.

records.subject: test(linux): preserve native paths across Bash fixture consumers
records.bug: Fourteen more Common fixtures corrupted POSIX path bytes.
records.root_cause: Local Bash conversion also confused the native path grammars consumed by Node, CPython and Lua.
records.regression_proof: 14 actual targets: old ordinary passes/backslash fails; all28 corrected paths pass, physical guards and Windows/POSIX boundary models.
records.os_scope: Common fixtures; Windows grammar modeled, no native Windows/Mac run claimed.

records.subject: fix(linux): preserve native digest fixture root paths
records.bug: The native digest helper failed standalone and on valid backslash checkouts.
records.root_cause: It normalized POSIX root bytes and relied on caller LUA_PATH to hide missing bootstrap.
records.regression_proof: Old standalone red; canonical bootstrap; three real ordinary/backslash/LF roots before12 unchanged native NIST/retirement controls,29 contract/model controls.
records.os_scope: Linux native digest helper only.

records.subject: chore(macos): clarify layout field probe comments
records.bug: Four valid Mac probe comments failed the Common plan-reference guard.
records.root_cause: Opaque P0/P5/P10 labels resembled forbidden planning references.
records.regression_proof: Unchanged guard old-red/new-green; comments-only edit and80 layout/install Lua cases.
records.os_scope: Mac comments scanned by Common; no product behavior changed.

records.subject: refactor(macos): share sorted pending shortcut keys
records.bug: Two shortcut retry owners failed the Common single-use helper gate.
records.root_cause: Each duplicated pairs-plus-sort despite importing TableUtil.
records.regression_proof: Unchanged gate old-red/new-green;8192 differential comparisons and6+3+18 owner cases plus8 helper contracts.
records.os_scope: Mac call sites only; shared helper already used by Linux unchanged.

records.subject: test(linux): separate Arch daemon and help launch contracts
records.bug: The Arch fixture demanded daemon side effects while asking only for help.
records.root_cause: It conflated pure help with real startup and left three relocation shell boundaries unquoted.
records.regression_proof: Old ordinary3/backslash4 failures; old launcher fails new help assertion;20 corrected executions and12 packaged help paths.
records.os_scope: Linux Arch install/launcher fixture, no real pacman or keyboard claim.

records.subject: fix(timings): centralize input-source refresh waits
records.bug: Two literal TIS refresh waits failed the Common timer gate.
records.root_cause: The Python worker duplicated a duration rather than accepting the shared timing registry.
records.regression_proof: Unchanged gate catches both literals; new argv assertion red on old worker; exact0.3s retained; Lua receipt and19 Python models.
records.os_scope: Only Mac loads Carbon; Common registry checks apply across hosts; no threshold raised.

records.subject: test(linux): keep malformed onboarding labels valid UTF-8
records.bug: Malformed onboarding subjects leaked invalid UTF-8 through their diagnostic names.
records.root_cause: LuaJIT percent-q preserved invalid bytes in timing labels; an initial pclose check also missed late failure.
records.regression_proof: Old output fails strict UTF-8;20 cases/825 frames pass; genuine825-frame child exiting73 is rejected.
records.os_scope: Linux tests only; eight malformed test subjects and assertion bodies retained.

records.subject: test(menu): follow the enabled layout confirmation owner
records.bug: Two Common menu guards rejected the current valid enabled-layout confirmation owner.
records.root_cause: The finite publication model still expected confirm_source_async instead of confirm_enabled_async.
records.regression_proof: Both actual old guards red/new green; seven source mutations per guard plus14 existing negatives retained.
records.os_scope: Common tests inspect all drivers; production unchanged.

records.subject: fix(test): reject malformed UTF-8 timing records
records.bug: Malformed UTF-8 lua_timing records were silently counted as valid machine receipts.
records.root_cause: StringDecoder/file UTF-8 decoding replaced bytes before JSON admission.
records.regression_proof: Original825-frame capture now admits823 and reports2 errors/exit1; identical50 vectors expose25 old violations and zero new;469 assertions.
records.os_scope: Shared Lua reporter; actual Windows TAP, human bytes and stderr contract retained.

records.subject: fix(linux): isolate private runner fixture output
records.bug: A deliberately failing private helper contaminated successful canonical runner output.
records.root_cause: Fresh private helper shared global print, leaking FAIL and nested headers despite a green outer tally.
records.regression_proof: Old real runner0 but receiver1; three canonical controls/seven child-receiver observations including genuine Lua5.4+compiled luv only; real outer failure remains fatal.
records.os_scope: Linux fixture only; no parser or product semantics changed.

records.subject: test(linux): expose the runner output gate through npm
records.bug: The new runner-output gate was registered without its mandatory npm alias.
records.root_cause: Suite registration and package script parity diverged.
records.regression_proof: Existing parity gate old1/new0; seven targeted gates and actual npm execution of three controls pass.
records.os_scope: Linux npm gate entry only.

records.subject: test(menu): follow the generated gesture information command
records.bug: The Common recommended-defaults guard rejected the valid Windows gesture information registration inherited from dev.
records.root_cause: A source-pattern assertion still required the retired raw string after production moved to the existing generated MenuCommand.GESTURE_RECOMMENDED_INFO constant.
records.regression_proof: Actual whole Common check487 and direct old-source target failed with registration assertion/exit1. The one-line expected registration pattern now follows the generated constant; the unchanged target passes. Seven targeted verification commands and normal hooks passed. No defaults, gesture processing, thresholds or production code changed.
records.os_scope: Common source-contract test for Windows registration; Mac and Linux registration assertions retained. No native Windows execution claimed.
